{"id":1946920303,"question_id":3496,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 1 week","timestamp":1773397830,"status":15,"status_display":"Runtime Error","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1946920303/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Number of Seconds to Make Mountain Height Zero","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    \n    bool ZyadaPhodDiyaYaNhi(int height , vector<int>&time , ll mid)\n    {\n        ll total = 0;\n        for(auto t : time)\n        {\n            ll val = (2 * mid) / t;\n            ll x = (sqrt(1 + 4 * val) - 1) / 2; \n            total += x;\n        }\n        return total >= height;\n    }\n\n    ll BS(int height, vector<int>& time)\n    {\n        ll s = 1;\n        ll e = *max_element(begin(time) , end(time)) * ((height * (height+1)) / 2);\n        ll ans = -1;\n\n        while(s <= e)\n        {\n            ll mid = s + (e-s)/2;   \n            if(ZyadaPhodDiyaYaNhi(height , time , mid))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else s = mid + 1;\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n\n    long long minNumberOfSeconds(int mountainHeight, vector<int>& workerTimes) {\n        return BS(mountainHeight , workerTimes);\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-number-of-seconds-to-make-mountain-height-zero","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1830}
